_note: Real lessons from the Maryland state standards, not invented ones. Every `objective` is the source document's own wording and every `standard` is a genuine code from that document -- do not edit either to make a lesson sound better, and do not invent codes for new lessons. The source PDFs are listed below.
_sources: Maryland College and Career Ready Standards in English Language Arts, State Board attachment 2025/0729
Maryland College and Career Ready Standards for Mathematics, State Board attachment 2025/0729 (PreK-8)
Next Generation Science Standards, adopted 2013 as the Maryland Science Standards
_provenance: Fetched, parsed and cited in the EduSystems project (Aug 2026); the PDFs live in that repo under docs/reference/. Carried across rather than re-scraped so the citations stay the verified ones.

lessons.name: Reading Fluency
lessons.source: Maryland CCR Standards for ELA (2025), p23
lessons.objective: Read (decode) with sufficient accuracy and fluency to support comprehension.

lessons.name: Basic Arithmetic
lessons.source: Maryland CCR Standards for Mathematics (2025), p47
lessons.objective: Fluently multiply and divide within 100, using strategies such as the relationship between multiplication and division.

lessons.name: Handwriting & Grammar
lessons.source: Maryland CCR Standards for ELA (2025), p80
lessons.objective: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.

lessons.name: Science Basics
lessons.objective: Make observations and measurements to identify materials based on their properties.

lessons.name: Map & Geography
lessons.objective: Inquire about the role of culture, technology, and the environment in the location, distribution, and impact of human activities using geographic tools and spatial thinking.

lessons.name: Pre-Algebra
lessons.source: Maryland CCR Standards for Mathematics (2025), p105
lessons.objective: Use variables to represent quantities in a real-world or mathematical problem, and construct simple equations and inequalities to solve problems by reasoning about the quantities.

lessons.name: Essay Writing
lessons.source: Maryland CCR Standards for ELA (2025), p1106
lessons.objective: Write arguments to support claims with clear reasons and relevant evidence.

lessons.name: Earth & Life Science
lessons.objective: Conduct an investigation to provide evidence that living things are made of cells; either one cell or many different numbers and types of cells.

lessons.name: World History
lessons.objective: Inquire about the people of the United States and the world using a historically grounded, multidisciplinary approach in order to recognize multiple narratives.

lessons.name: Speaking & Listening
lessons.source: Maryland CCR Standards for ELA (2025), p885
lessons.objective: Present claims and findings, emphasizing salient points in a focused, coherent manner with relevant evidence, sound valid reasoning, and well-chosen details.
